known_characteristics: Class balance: 55 True / 645 False = 11.73:1 SEVERE imbalance
user_id: 10.3% null, channel: 5.6% null, time_on_site_s: 5.4% null

No time-series structure despite session_date column — sessions are independent

task_type.note: Target is boolean converted — unambiguously binary classification. time_series_forecasting would be wrong; sessions are independent events, not a time series.

class_balance_issue.note: 11.73:1 imbalance is severe. Accuracy is a misleading metric here (92% accuracy by predicting all False). The skill must recognise this.

data_readiness.note: Either acceptable. 'needs_prep' is better given multiple null columns. 'insufficient' is incorrect.

imbalance_ratio.note: Exact ratio is 11.73. The severe imbalance (>10:1) should be prominently noted.

recommendations.imbalance_handling_note: At 11.73:1, the recommendations MUST address the imbalance explicitly. Acceptable signals: scale_pos_weight, class_weight='balanced', SMOTE, precision-recall curve as primary metric, F1 or AUC-PR over accuracy. Missing this is a critical quality failure for this benchmark. Removed 'regression' — logistic regression with class_weight is valid for imbalanced classification.
